definitions.explanation: Prefix indicating possession by the speaker's group, used in formal or literary contexts.
Used in literature or dramatic contexts to mean 'my.'

examples.japanese: {我|わ}が{国|くに}の{文化|ぶんか}を{紹介|しょうかい}する。
{我|わ}が{社|しゃ}は{創業|そうぎょう}50{年|ねん}を{迎|むか}えた。
{我|わ}が{子|こ}の{成長|せいちょう}を{見守|みまも}る。
examples.english: To watch over my child's growth.

examples.japanese: {我|わ}が{校|こう}の{伝統|でんとう}を{誇|ほこ}りに{思|おも}う。
examples.english: I am proud of our school's traditions.

examples.japanese: {我|わ}が{人生|じんせい}に{悔|く}いはない。
examples.english: I have no regrets in my life.

examples.japanese: {我|わ}が{家|や}に{帰|かえ}るとほっとする。
examples.english: I feel relieved when I return home.

notes:
{我|わ}が〜 is a formal/literary prefix meaning 'our' or 'my.'

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {我|わ}が{国|くに} (our country; Japan)
- {我|わ}が{社|しゃ} (our company)
- {我|わ}が{家|や}/{我|わ}が{家|いえ} (my home; our home)
- {我|わ}が{子|こ} (my child)
- {我|わ}が{身|み} (oneself)
- {我|わ}が{道|みち} (one's own way)
- {我|わ}が{輩|はい} (I/we - archaic, as in {吾輩|わがはい}は{猫|ねこ}である)

REGISTER:
This prefix has a formal, literary, or patriotic tone. In everyday speech:
- 'our country' → {日本|にほん}, うちの{国|くに}
- 'our company' → うちの{会社|かいしゃ}
- 'my child' → {私|わたし}の{子供|こども}, うちの{子|こ}

IDIOMS:
- {我|わ}が{物顔|ものがお} (acting as if one owns the place)
